purpose: Scoring model for a shared soundtrack between any two characters; romance is optional.
principle: Do not average two characters into one. Build a relationship profile from the interaction between them, then use character profiles as secondary context.

scoring.intersection: For each emotional dimension, compare both character values and reward dimensions present in both.
scoring.contrast: For each dimension, reward strong opposition when the selected focus is conflict, tension, rivalry, or transformation.
scoring.relationship: Map relationship type and its six-axis profile into song tags and emotional dimensions.
scoring.trajectory: Map the direction of the relationship to transition, loss, growth, betrayal, danger, hope, or reconciliation tags.
scoring.character_context: Use race, role, sphere, current arc and future arc only as secondary modifiers.
scoring.diversity: After ranking, penalize repeated artists, near-duplicate genres and songs with almost identical emotional profiles.
scoring.romance_guard: Never infer romance from attraction alone. Attraction may represent fascination, rivalry, obsession, danger, or supernatural pull. Romantic framing requires an explicitly romantic relationship type or trajectory.

output_modes.label: Их песня
output_modes.purpose: One track that best represents the relationship itself.

output_modes.label: Их история
output_modes.purpose: One track representing the relationship arc from beginning to possible outcome.

output_modes.label: Их противостояние
output_modes.purpose: One track emphasizing tension, opposition, danger and power.

privacy_note: Use only public generator archetypes and generic relationship categories. Do not encode private player lore, private families, unpublished AUs or specific personal story references.
